title: Pure Mythical beast
summary: Mythical Beast is a Scale 4 LIGHT/DARK Spellcaster Pendulum and Spell Counter control archetype where every Pendulum Effect activates only while you have NO card in your OTHER Pendulum Zone—destroying itself in the Pendulum Zone to search or Special Summon another Mythical Beast! Place Mythical Beast Master Cerberus in an empty Pendulum Zone and pop it to search Mythical Beast Jackal King; place Jackal King in your now-empty Pendulum Zone and pop it to Special Summon Master Cerberus face-up from your Extra Deck! Every Spell activation places 2 Spell Counters on Master Cerberus (banishing an opponent's monster and making Cerberus immune to card destruction) and 2 Spell Counters on Jackal King (negating and destroying an opponent's monster effect)!

allow.Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic: Scale 8 Level 7 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum boss that removes 6 Spell Counters from your field to Special Summon itself from the Pendulum Zone and destroy cards on the field, and bounces a Spell Counter card to negate any Spell/Trap!
allow.Servant of Endymion: Scale 2 Level 3 Spellcaster Pendulum that gains Spell Counters from your Spells and removes 3 Spell Counters to Special Summon itself AND any monster that you can place a Spell Counter on with 1000+ ATK (Mythical Beast Master Cerberus or Jackal King!) directly from your Deck!
allow.Spell Power Mastery: Normal Spell that adds Servant of Endymion or Endymion from your Deck to your hand and places Spell Counters on your Mythical Beasts and Mythical Institution.
allow.Magical Abductor: Scale 3 Level 4 Spellcaster Pendulum that gains a Spell Counter for every Spell activated and removes 3 Spell Counters in the Pendulum Zone to search ANY Pendulum Monster from your Deck.
allow.Upstart Goblin: Limited to 1 in TCG: draws 1 card with zero restrictions and places 2 Spell Counters on Master Cerberus, 2 on Jackal King, and 2 on Mythical Institution!
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 Spellcaster that gains 3+ Spell Counters on Link Summon and removes 3 Spell Counters during either player's Main Phase to Special Summon Mythical Beast Jackal King or Master Cerberus from your hand or GY!
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Master Cerberus, Jackal King, or Servant of Endymion.

main: Mythical Beast Master Cerberus

Core Scale 4 Level 8 LIGHT Spellcaster boss (2800 ATK): while you have no card in your other Pendulum Zone, destroys itself in the Pendulum Zone to search any Level 7 or lower 'Mythical Beast' monster; on the field, gains 2 Spell Counters per Spell, cannot be destroyed while you control 4+ counters, and removes 4 counters to banish 1 opponent's monster!
Mythical Beast Jackal King

Core Scale 4 Level 6 DARK Spellcaster boss (2400 ATK): while you have no card in your other Pendulum Zone, destroys itself in the Pendulum Zone to Special Summon 1 face-up 'Mythical Beast' Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck; on the field, gains 2 Spell Counters per Spell and removes 2 counters as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy an opponent's monster effect!
Mythical Beast Jackal

Scale 4 Level 1 DARK Spellcaster: destroys itself in your single Pendulum Zone to place 1 Spell Counter on a card you control; removes 3 Spell Counters from your field + tributes itself to Special Summon Mythical Beast Master Cerberus or Jackal King directly from your Deck!
Mythical Beast Garuda

Scale 4 Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster handtrap: destroys itself in your single Pendulum Zone to destroy 1 Spell/Trap on the field; when your opponent summons a monster (Quick Effect), removes 3 Spell Counters from your field to Special Summon itself from hand and bounce that monster!
Mythical Beast Bashilisk
Scale 4 Level 4 EARTH Spellcaster: destroys itself in your single Pendulum Zone to shuffle 1 face-up Spellcaster Pendulum from your Extra Deck into the Deck and draw 1 card.
Mythical Beast Medusa
Scale 4 Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster: destroys itself in your single Pendulum Zone to revive a monster from your GY and place a Spell Counter on it.
Servant of Endymion
Gains a Spell Counter for each Spell activated and removes 3 counters from your field to Special Summon itself + Mythical Beast Master Cerberus or Jackal King directly from your Deck!
Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic
Scale 8 boss that removes 6 Spell Counters from your Mythical Beast board to Special Summon itself, pop cards without targeting, and negate Spells/Traps.
Magical Abductor
Removes 3 Spell Counters in the Pendulum Zone to search any Mythical Beast Pendulum Monster from your Deck.
Mythical Institution

Signature Continuous Spell: gains 2 Spell Counters every time a Mythical Beast monster is destroyed by battle or card effect, and removes ANY number of Spell Counters to search a Spellcaster with a matching Level!
Mythical Bestiary
Signature Quick-Play Spell: sends cards from the top of your Deck to the GY up to the number of cards your opponent controls, then places Spell Counters on a card you control.
Spell Power Mastery
Searches Servant of Endymion or Endymion and places Spell Counters across your field.
Upstart Goblin
Limited to 1 in TCG: draws 1 card and generates Spell Counters across every Mythical Beast on your board.
extra: Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters for every Spell on the field and in the GYs, and removes 3 counters to revive Mythical Beast King Jackal or Master Cerberus in Defense Position!
Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Master Cerberus, King Jackal, or Garuda.
